calibration_sources: VTC: Fairness in Serving Large Language Models (OSDI Virtual Token Counter & Wake-Up Counter Lift)
Deficit Round-Robin (DRR) / Weighted Fair Queuing (WFQ) with Asymmetric Prefill vs. Decode Token Weights
Work-Conserving Hierarchical Token-Bucket Rate Limiting with Sub-Chunk (512-Token) Preemption

workload.cluster_and_tenants: 64x H100 80GB Shared Serving Platform hosting 16 Interactive Chat Tenants (500 in / 200 out) + 4 Heavy Batch/RAG Tenants (64K in / 4K out)
workload.cost_asymmetry: 1 heavy request (64K in + 4K out) consumes ~105x more GPU service time than 1 chat request, breaking request-count (RPM) fairness
workload.vtc_formula: Virtual Token Counter (OSDI VTC): delta_v_i = (w_cached * T_cached + w_prefill * T_uncached_in + w_decode * T_out) / tenant_weight_i

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统 FCFS 先来先服务队列 (1 个 64K 批量租户瞬间塞满队列，交互租户 P99 TTFT 飙至 4,850ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Vanilla FCFS Shared Queue (Batch Flood Starves Interactive P99 TTFT to 4,850ms)
tiers.fairness_and_scheduling_policy: Single global FIFO queue without tenant isolation or token-cost weighting
tiers.idle_capacity_and_preemption: Heavy 64K prefill bursts monopolize GPU batch slots for 45+ seconds at a time
tiers.recommended_for: Single-tenant internal batch jobs only; unusable for multi-tenant enterprise platforms.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 按请求数轮询 Round-Robin / RPM 限流 (把 64K 巨型请求与 500 词短对话当成 1:1 等价，仍卡顿 1,620ms)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Per-Tenant Request Round-Robin / RPM Limit (Ignores 105x Token Size Asymmetry -> 1,620ms TTFT)
tiers.fairness_and_scheduling_policy: Alternates 1 request per tenant; ignores that 1 batch request equals 105 chat requests in GPU time
tiers.idle_capacity_and_preemption: Heavy tenant's single turn still blocks 15 chat turns; Output-Token-Per-Minute (OTPM) bursts cause OOMs
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy API gateways with uniform fixed-length prompts only.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 标准 VTC 虚拟令牌公平队列 (加权计费 C=1.0*T_in+2.5*T_out + 唤醒对齐 + 静态硬限流 -> 闲置 28.5% 算力)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Standard VTC Virtual Token Counter + Hard Rate Cap (285ms TTFT · 0.96 Fairness · 71.5% GPU Util)
tiers.fairness_and_scheduling_policy: Schedules min(v_i) using weighted Prefill/Decode/Cached token costs + lifts v_i on wake-up to prevent credit hoarding
tiers.idle_capacity_and_preemption: Strict non-work-conserving TPM caps leave 28.5% of GPUs idle when interactive tenants are quiet
tiers.recommended_for: Strict multi-tenant isolation where unused capacity does not need to be recycled to spot/batch jobs.

tiers.name: Tier 4: SLO 分层 VTC + 弹性空闲借用 (Work-Conserving Borrow) + 512词分块抢占 (210ms TTFT · 94.8% 满载率)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: SLO-Aware Hierarchical VTC + Work-Conserving Spot Borrow + 512-Tok Chunk Preemption (210ms · 94.8% Util)
tiers.fairness_and_scheduling_policy: Weighted VTC (w_cache=0.05, w_in=1.0, w_out=2.5) + Dual Priority (Guaranteed Base vs Spot Borrow)
tiers.idle_capacity_and_preemption: Batch tenants borrow 100% idle GPUs when chat is quiet, preempted in <18ms at 512-token chunk boundary on chat arrival
tiers.recommended_for: Enterprise AI gateways & shared GPU platforms mixing real-time chat/agents with offline batch/eval workloads.
